page_title: LIL 1-4 STR | Lille v Strasbourg 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+3' 1 - 4 Goal! Marius Broholm finds Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom left corner. Fantasy football! 1:4.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Ethan Mbappe is replaced by Marius Broholm (Lille).
87' Joaquin Panichelli goes off the pitch and Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg) comes on.
85' The ball is cleared after Ethan Mbappe (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

82' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Soriba Diaoune (Lille), whose header flies way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Felix Correia (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Olivier Giroud.
80' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:6.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Julio Enciso will be replaced by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg).
76' Gary O'Neil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) replacing Diego Moreira.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Guela Doue walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rafael Luis (Strasbourg).
74' A rebound falls kindly for Julio Enciso (Strasbourg), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.

72' 0 - 4 Julio Enciso is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Martial Godo (Strasbourg) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 0:4.
70' The game has come to an end for Romain Perraud. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Calvin Verdonk (Lille).
70' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Tiago Santos and he is replaced by Soriba Diaoune (Lille).
70' It is time for a substitution. Thomas Meunier (Lille) is on for Aissa Mandi.

66' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Berke Ozer guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
66' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
64' Willy Delajod shows the yellow card to Romain Perraud (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
62' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Willy Delajod to decide. The relieved Strasbourg players can finally celebrate.
61' That will be all from Samir El Mourabet who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
59' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Willy Delajod is going to take a look using VAR.
58' 0 - 3 Goal! A great cross from Martial Godo finds Martial Godo (Strasbourg), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 0:3.

57' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
57' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
56' Olivier Giroud (Lille) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.
55' A yellow card is awarded to Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg).
54' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
52' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

51' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
50' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
50' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Lille.
48' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.

46' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
46' Referee Willy Delajod blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Chancel Mbemba (Lille) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
45+3' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Mike Penders has no trouble gathering it.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
42' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
42' The corner by Ethan Mbappe (Lille) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
40' What a chance that is! Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
39' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

39' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the top right corner. Mike Penders is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
36' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) picks up a yellow card.
36' Booking. Guela Doue (Strasbourg) receives a caution from the referee.
36' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Berke Ozer is alert and denies him.

35' Olivier Giroud (Lille) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
33' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
32' Willy Delajod blows his whistle after Ethan Mbappe (Lille) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
29' Romain Perraud (Lille) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
26' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Joaquin Panichelli tees up Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) inside the box and he slams the ball past Berke Ozer.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Guela Doue sets up Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the right side of the goal. 0:1.
24' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
22' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' My Gran could have done better! Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
18' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
18' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Willy Delajod stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
16' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
11' The resulting free kick from 24 metres out taken by Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) was blocked by the defensive wall, which was perfectly positioned by the goalkeeper.
10' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and signals a foul after Chancel Mbemba (Lille) brought his opponent down. Strasbourg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
9' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

6' Olivier Giroud (Lille) decides to try his luck with a first-time bullet of a shot. Unfortunately for him, he doesn't hit the ball perfectly and his effort ends well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
2' Nathan Ngoy (Lille) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
1' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) is about to take a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
